data.name: Befuddling Strike
data.description: Befuddling Strike forces a foe damaged by your unarmed attack to attempt a DC %1 Fortitude saving throw, in addition to dealing damage normally. You must declare that you are using this feat before you make your attack roll-thus, a failed attack roll ruins the attempt. A defender who fails this saving throw is confused for 1d4 rounds. You can use Befuddling Strike %2 times per day, but no more than once per round. Constructs, incorporeal creatures, mindless creatures, plants, undead, and creatures that are immune to critical hits cannot be affected by this ability.|CL/2+10+WIS|BefuddlingStrikeTimes
